SNEL JE DAGBOEK INVULLEN MET DE BARCODE-SCANNER

120.000 MERKPRODUCTEN

AFVALLEN

1. Hoeveel je bent afgevallen en feedback op je gewichtsverloop.

BEWEEGMETER

WAT MAAKT MIJN EETMETER UNIEK?
1. Helemaal gratis en zonder commercieel belang

1. Drag to set your custom intervals for workout, rest, rounds, etc
2. Tap to start.

Interval Timer doesn't interfere with your music or other apps:
∙ Listen to your music apps while you workout.
∙ Voice or beep guides for every workout.
∙ You can leave the app and still listen to the audio guides, in order to follow a workout you found online.

And no need to manually record your workouts:
∙ Detailed history and statistics pages to track your progress.
∙ Repeat a previous workout from your history, so you don't need to set it again.

If you have any ideas for how to improve the app, just tap "Contact Support' inside the app and let us know! We are always trying to improve Interval Timer
